# Test #cgo noescape and #cgo nocallback directives with Go-syntax bindings.
env GOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT,runtimecgopurego,cgobindings
[!GOEXPERIMENT:cgobindings] skip
[!GOOS:darwin] [!GOOS:linux] skip
[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip
[!exec:cc] skip

cd p
cc -fPIC -shared -o libtest.so ../c/lib.c

env CGO_ENABLED=bindings
env CC=/bin/false
go build -gcflags=-m -o app.exe .
stderr 'noesc does not escape'
stderr 'leaking param: esc'

[GOOS:linux] env LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.
exec ./app.exe
stdout 'Add=15'
stdout 'Esc=25'

! exec ./app.exe cb
stderr 'runtime: function marked with #cgo nocallback called back into Go'
cd ..

cd errpkg
! go build -o app_err.exe .
stderr '#cgo noescape NoSuchFunc: no matched C function'
stderr '#cgo nocallback AnotherNoSuchFunc: no matched C function'

-- c/lib.c --
int Add(int *p, int b) { return *p + b; }
int Esc(int *p, int b) { return *p + b; }
typedef int (*cb_fn)(int, int);
int CallMeBack(cb_fn cb, int a, int b) { return cb(a, b); }
-- p/go.mod --
module p
go 1.28
-- p/binding.go --
package main

// #cgo LDFLAGS: ./libtest.so
// #cgo noescape Add
// #cgo nocallback Add
// #cgo nocallback CallMeBack
import "C"

//cgo:type cb_fn C.cb_fn
//cgo:func Add C.Add "libtest.so"
//cgo:func Esc C.Esc "libtest.so"
//cgo:func CallMeBack C.CallMeBack "libtest.so"

type cb_fn *[0]byte

func Add(p *int32, b int32) int32
func Esc(p *int32, b int32) int32
func CallMeBack(cb cb_fn, a, b int32) int32
-- p/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

import "C"

//export GoCallback
func GoCallback(a, b int32) int32 { return a + b }

func testNoEscape(noesc *int32) int32 { return C.Add(noesc, 10) }
func testEscape(esc *int32) int32     { return C.Esc(esc, 10) }

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "cb" {
		C.CallMeBack(C.cb_fn(C.GoCallback), 10, 20)
		return
	}
	var v1, v2 int32 = 5, 15
	fmt.Printf("Add=%d\n", testNoEscape(&v1))
	fmt.Printf("Esc=%d\n", testEscape(&v2))
}
-- errpkg/go.mod --
module errpkg
go 1.28
-- errpkg/binding.go --
package main

// #cgo LDFLAGS: ./libtest.so
import "C"

//cgo:func Add C.Add "libtest.so"
func Add(p *int32, b int32) int32
-- errpkg/main.go --
package main

// #cgo noescape NoSuchFunc
// #cgo nocallback AnotherNoSuchFunc
import "C"

func main() {}
